hints.title: Concentric Layer Expansion
hints.text: At minute 1 there is 1 cell. At each subsequent minute k, 4 * (k - 1) newly colored boundary cells are added.

hints.title: Closed-Form Simplification
hints.text: Using the triangular number formula, the sum evaluates directly to 1 + 2 * n * (n - 1).

hints.title: Closed-Form Cell Count Implementation

complexity.notes: Closed-form formula evaluation executes in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating minute-by-minute cell propagation takes O(n^2) time.
